answer_1.quote: LLMs have demonstrated remarkable success across various reasoning tasks, including mathematical problem-solving, code generation, multimodality, agent, and common-sense reasoning.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate reasoning paths (rationales) and final answers for math word problems and other reasoning tasks using chain-of-thought prompting and are evaluated on their ability to solve in-domain and out-of-domain reasoning tasks.
